attack_path.action: The calculated TVL of a vault is the basis to determine how much value a user gets when withdrawing shares from the vault.

attack_path.action: Gain access to mint unlimited amounts of DcntEth token, which could be used to disrupt the crosschain accounting mechanism, or to steal the deposited weth in the DecentEthRouter contract.
Burn all the DcntEth tokens that were issued to the DecentEthRouter contract when liquidity providers deposited their WETH or ETH into it.

comparison_finding.claimed_behaviour: By allowing anybody to set the address of the Router contract to any address they want to set it allows malicious users to get access to the mint and burn functions of the DcntEth contract.

claimed_impact._source: sentence(s) from the finding's own impact/description prose; empty means the report does not state this dimension
claimed_impact.financial: Gain access to mint unlimited amounts of DcntEth token, which could be used to disrupt the crosschain accounting mechanism, or to steal the deposited weth in the DecentEthRouter contract.

comparison_finding.title: Anyone can update the address of the Router in the DcntEth contract to any address they would like to set.

input.prompt: Two security submissions from the same audit are given: a candidate and a comparison finding. Decide whether they describe the same vulnerability (same root cause such that one fix would address both), a distinct vulnerability, or ambiguous when the evidence does not establish either. The published status, the duplicate pointer and the identifiers of the two records are deliberately withheld; do not infer them.
input.triage_policy: Code4rena treats reports sharing one root cause as duplicates; Immunefi additionally asks whether the same fix addresses both and whether the relevant files or endpoints differ
